summary: Iteration 79 - Technical Contacts and Bitácora Module. All 14/14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Create/Edit integrator form shows 'Responsables Técnicos' section with dynamic rows, Bitácora modal opens with form and chronological history, entries save successfully and auto-update last_contact_date, has_overdue_commitments flag correctly computed.

issues: React hydration warning about <span> in <tbody> - internal tooling issue, not affecting functionality

seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed integrators
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 79 complete. Features tested: 1) POST /api/integrators with contacts array [{name, email, phone}] - creates integrator with technical contacts, each contact gets auto-generated contact_id. 2) PUT /api/integrators/{id} - updates contacts array. 3) GET /api/integrators - returns has_overdue_commitments flag (true if any bitácora entry has commitment_deadline < today and commitment_completed=false). 4) POST /api/integrators/{id}/bitacora - creates entry with description, contact_id, contact_name, date, commitment, commitment_deadline, auto-updates last_contact_date on integrator. 5) GET /api/integrators/{id}/bitacora - returns entries sorted by date descending. 6) PATCH /api/integrators/{id}/bitacora/{entry_id} - marks commitment as completed (commitment_completed=true). 7) DELETE /api/integrators/{id}/bitacora/{entry_id} - removes entry. Frontend: Form shows 'Responsables Técnicos' section with 'Agregar responsable' button, contact rows have name/email/phone fields with icons, Bitácora button (BookOpen icon) in table actions opens modal with form and historial.

POST_integrators_with_contacts.description: Creates integrator with contacts array, each contact gets contact_id

GET_integrators_has_overdue_commitments_.description: Returns false when no bitácora entries or no overdue commitments
Returns true when bitácora entry has past deadline and not completed

GET_bitacora_chronological_order.description: Entries returned in descending date order

completed_commitment_not_overdue.description: Completed commitments with past deadline don't flag as overdue
